mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and retail sales (RSAFS > 750,000) signals robust consumer demand, increasing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 750,000 fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, raising recession risks and suppressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above CPIAUCSL 330 signals sustained price pressures, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 330.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent job growth (PAYEMS > 158,000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 4.2%) indicates accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 158,000 and UNRATE < 4.2% fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above 102 signals manufacturing recovery, increasing corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.
